Welcome to Hilltown Auto Repairs.
How may I help you?
Hi, I've been having trouble with the air conditioning in my car.
It hasn't been working this past week, so driving in this heat has been really uncomfortable.
I understand.
Well, here's our price list.
If the cost for fixing that is okay with you, I can have that done by the end of the day.
Yes, that's fine.
Okay.
And do you already have a customer account here?
Yes, my last name's Juntaza.
Mr. Juntaza.
Okay, I see your name in our system.
I actually moved last month, so you have my old address in your system.
Let me give you the new one.

欢迎来到 Hilltown Auto Repairs。

如果修理的费用对您来说没问题，我可以在今天结束前完成。
是的，可以。
好的。
您这里有客户账户吗？
是的，我的姓是 Juntaza。
Juntaza 先生。
好的，我在我们的系统里看到了您的名字。
我上个月其实搬家了，所以您的系统里还有我以前的地址。
让我给您新的。
